name: Gemini 305g
summary: Gemini 305g is the GMSL2/FAKRA variant of the Gemini 305 close-range stereo camera for robot wrists. It provides RGB-D and dual-color perception while supporting flexible cabling under repeated twisting and bending. Its IP65 enclosure and retained USB-C development interface support deployment in moving robotic arms.

sources.quote: To meet the rigorous demands of high-frequency dynamic routing on robotic arms, Orbbec also launched the Gemini 305g variant, equipped with GMSL2 serializer and FAKRA connector plus highly flexible, low-loss cabling. GMSL2/FAKRA connectivity grants the Gemini 305g markedly more stable and consistent data transmission than USB cameras, easily shrugging off mechanical vibration, electromagnetic interference, and other environmental adversities.
